# Empty State

```tsx
import { EmptyState, EmptyStateIcon, EmptyStateHeader, EmptyStateTitle, EmptyStateDescription, EmptyStateActions, emptyStateVariants } from "@s0l/design-system"
```

Placeholder shown when there is no content to display. The icon is an Icon Colors with container.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<EmptyState {...args} className="w-90">
  {showIcon && <EmptyStateIcon />}
  <EmptyStateHeader>
    {showTitle && <EmptyStateTitle>{title}</EmptyStateTitle>}
    <EmptyStateDescription>{description}</EmptyStateDescription>
  </EmptyStateHeader>
  {showActions && (
    <EmptyStateActions>
      <Button>Label</Button>
      {showAction2 && <Button variant="secondary">Label</Button>}
    </EmptyStateActions>
  )}
</EmptyState>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Empty State component: Direction (Inline / Stacked) sets how the actions are laid out. Icon, Title and Actions are optional parts, like the Show Icon / Show Title / Show Actions toggles in Figma.

## Variants

`emptyStateVariants` (cva):

| Prop | Options | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `direction` | `inline`, `stacked` | `inline` |

## Rules

- Import `EmptyState` from `@s0l/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
